stories.title: Sheinbaum defiende participación del canciller Velasco en la ONU; confirma asistencia a la APEC en China

en.title: Sheinbaum defends Foreign Minister Velasco's participation at the UN; confirms attendance at APEC in China
en.summary: Mexico's President defended Foreign Minister Velasco's role at the United Nations General Assembly and confirmed she will attend the APEC summit in China.

stories.title: Rubio intentará lograr tregua en ataques energéticos entre Ucrania y Rusia: invita a Putin a la cumbre del G20 en EU

en.title: Rubio will attempt to achieve truce in energy attacks between Ukraine and Russia: invites Putin to G20 summit in US
en.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov to seek a ceasefire in energy attacks between Ukraine and Russia, and invited Putin to the G20 summit.

stories.title: Confirma CSP viaje a China para cumbre de APEC

en.title: CSP confirms trip to China for APEC summit
en.summary: Mexico's President confirmed travel to China in November for the APEC summit, where Mexico will assume leadership to host the 2028 meeting.

stories.title: Rubio invita a Putin a cumbre del G20 en diciembre que se celebrará en Miami

en.title: Rubio invites Putin to G20 summit in December to be held in Miami
en.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced that the United States has invited Russian President Vladimir Putin to attend the G20 leaders' summit scheduled for December in Miami.

en.title: 'Polo' Weakens to Category 4 Hurricane
en.summary: Hurricane Polo has decreased in intensity to category 4 status. Heavy rainfall, strong winds, and high waves continue affecting coastal areas across five states.

stories.title: Gobierno reporta avance en red ferroviaria: Habrá 2,400 kilómetros de trenes en el sexenio de Sheinbaum

en.title: Government Reports Progress on Rail Network: 2,400 Kilometers of Trains During Sheinbaum Administration
en.summary: Mexico's government announced construction advances on a new passenger rail network connecting central and northern regions. The project aims to serve approximately 41 million people with an investment near 750 billion pesos.

stories.title: Polonia denuncia una violación de su espacio aéreo por parte de un helicóptero militar de Rusia

en.title: Poland Denounces Russian Military Helicopter Airspace Violation
en.summary: Polish military reported a Russian Mi-8 helicopter crossed into Polish airspace near the Kaliningrada border on Tuesday. Poland accuses Russia of testing its defensive capabilities.

stories.title: Polonia denuncia violación en su espacio aéreo por incursión de helicóptero ruso; activan sistemas de defensa terrestre

en.title: Poland Denounces Airspace Violation from Russian Helicopter Incursion; Ground Defense Systems Activated
en.summary: Poland reported a Russian helicopter airspace violation near its border with Kaliningrada. Ground defense systems were activated in response to the incident.

stories.title: Gobierno fija meta de 2 mil 400 km en obras de trenes de pasajeros; “con la transformación llegó el rescate”, expresa Sheinbaum

en.title: Government sets goal of 2,400 km in passenger train works; "transformation brought rescue", expresses Sheinbaum
en.summary: The government has established a target of 2,400 kilometers for passenger railway construction projects, with officials noting the initiative will connect regions and communities inhabited by 41 million people.

stories.title: Javier Aguirre es el nuevo entrenador de Valencia; suma su séptimo club en España

en.title: Javier Aguirre is Valencia's new coach; adds his seventh club in Spain
en.summary: Javier Aguirre, 67, who served as Mexico's national team coach until July, has been named as Valencia's new manager, marking his seventh position with a Spanish club.

stories.title: Huracán Polo baja a categoría 4; lleva 24 horas estacionado frente a Guerrero y Colima; en vivo, últimas noticias de este fenómeno

en.title: Hurricane Polo downgraded to category 4; stationary for 24 hours off Guerrero and Colima; live coverage, latest news on this phenomenon
en.summary: Hurricane Polo has weakened to category 4 and remains stationary off the coasts of Guerrero and Colima, with authorities warning of potential landslides, river flooding, and inundation in low-lying areas.

stories.title: Oficializa Valencia llegada de Javier Aguirre como DT

en.title: Valencia officially announces Javier Aguirre's arrival as manager
en.summary: Valencia has confirmed an agreement with Javier Aguirre to serve as the club's manager through the end of the season.

stories.title: Plan México necesita algo más que inversión para funcionar, advierte Mariana Mazzucato

en.title: Plan México needs more than investment to work, warns Mariana Mazzucato
en.summary: Economist Mariana Mazzucato cautioned that Mexico possesses various policy tools but must integrate them toward shared objectives rather than implementing them separately.

stories.title: Emilio Azcárraga quiere ascenso y descenso, pero explica por qué hoy no es viable económicamente en México

en.title: Emilio Azcárraga wants promotion and relegation, but explains why it is not economically viable in Mexico today
en.summary: The América football club chairman expressed support for implementing promotion and relegation but outlined economic reasons why such a system is currently not feasible in Mexico.

stories.title: La china Changan va por el trono de Toyota: su nuevo plan para entregar refacciones en tiempo récord

en.title: Chinese Changan aims for Toyota's throne: its new plan to deliver spare parts in record time
en.summary: Changan has partnered with Estafeta to compete with established Japanese automakers in Mexico by offering faster spare parts delivery.

stories.title: Soriana acelera inversión con más de 961 mdp para abrir y remodelar tiendas en el país

en.title: Soriana accelerates investment with over 961 million pesos to open and remodel stores in the country
en.summary: Soriana will invest over 961 million pesos to open and remodel 26 stores, create 1,000 jobs in Nuevo León and Veracruz, and strengthen its omnichannel operations.

stories.title: El Nokia 1100 también se fabricó en México: la planta que estuvo detrás del celular más vendido en la historia

en.title: The Nokia 1100 was also manufactured in Mexico: the plant behind the best-selling phone in history
en.summary: Mexico manufactured the world's best-selling mobile phone, the Nokia 1100, as well as other Nokia models.
